purpose: bounded feasibility test for whether an initial-rate-separated, nonnegative-barrier pair can be advanced through the public stochastic kMC implementation

pair_provenance.selection_rule: maximum nonnegative-barrier aggregate-rate ratio within the frozen 0.25 meV mean-barrier tolerance at comp=0.9

feasibility_rule: pass only if all six requested runs complete and every final simulated time, D_J, tracer diffusivity, conductivity, and MSD is finite with positive simulated time
analysis_policy: Report paired per-seed ratios, medians, ranges, and trajectory curves. Do not change seeds, pass count, pair, or endpoint after inspection.
interpretation_boundary: Thirty measurement passes are 1% of the source paper's 3,000-pass setting. This pilot cannot establish converged conductivity, Haven ratio, mechanism, or experimental transfer; it only informs whether a production run is computationally and numerically viable.
sealed_test_interaction: This pilot does not access or alter the paper-level sealed benchmark test.
